data.action: 双手调好贝雷帽帽檐，露出满意的小笑容。
data.description: 帽子店的木架前，加奈穿棕色格纹外套和藏蓝阔腿裤，双手调整刚试上的贝雷帽。她用余光检查帽檐位置，原本挑剔的表情慢慢变成藏不住的满意，红色短发从帽沿露出。
data.promptProse: Kana adjusts a newly tried brown beret with both hands before the hat shop's wooden racks, checking its brim sideways before her critical expression relaxes into satisfaction. Her rust-brown checked jacket and cream blouse sit above navy wide-leg trousers in medium view. Hats overlap along shelves behind her. Warm diffuse shop light reveals the felt and checks, shading the red hair emerging just beneath the brim.
data.title: 有马加奈 · 棕色贝雷帽的试戴
